about_the_game:
Ever wonder what treasures are hidden in your shopping bag?
Grocery Bag Clicker is a lighthearted clicker game where every bag you open reveals a surprise. Collect food, coupons, and rare golden goods, then trade them with friends or list them on the Steam Community Market.

Inspired by viral item-drop clickers, this game focuses on the thrill of discovery, rarity, and collection — all with a grocery-store twist.

Features include:

  • 🛍️ Click-to-Open Fun: Each bag click drops a random item.

  • 🍞 Item Rarity System: From common cans of beans to ultra-rare Golden Shopping Carts.

  • 📦 Inventory Collection: Track your haul and show off rare finds.

  • 💸 Marketplace Integration: Trade or sell items with other players.

  • 🎉 Seasonal Events: Special holiday groceries, limited-time coupons, and themed surprises.

  • 🔔 Idle Drops: Keep the game running and receive drops over time, even when you’re not clicking.

Whether you’re here to chase memes, flip rare digital groceries, or simply pass the time, Grocery Bag Clicker offers endless idle fun — and the chance to strike it big with the rarest finds.
